description:
Remove the executor's disk-backed configuration, namespace and rule caches, move their last readers and tests onto captured declarations, delete `get_hierarchy_config` and `ConfigManager`, keeping its pure conversions as free functions, and delete `JitConfig::load`, so no command reads declarations from a per-process cache that can disagree with the captured image, and `config.rs` and the declaration modules only parse and merge.

## Background

- `CommandExecutor` holds `rules`, `effective_rules`, `config` and `namespaces` as `OnceLock`s (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2129-2149`, initialised at `:2180-2183`), filled by `rules()` (`:2480-2492`, which calls `crate::storage::ruleset_store::load_ruleset` on the live root through `config_manager`), `effective_rules()` (`:2523-2553`, which probes `rules.toml` on disk and reconciles default rules with the namespace registry), `cached_config()` (`:2560-2568`, `config_manager.load()`), `cached_namespaces()` (`:2574-2592`) and `repo_content_format()` (`:2595`). `worktree_paths` (`:2170`) is an injected authority, not configuration, and stays.
- After the read paths, bulk preview, lease check and executor-side validation views have moved off them, no production reader remains. `CommandExecutor::container_anchor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/template.rs:98-100`) reads `self.cached_config()?.templates.anchors`, but only tests call it (`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_binding_tests.rs:161, 219, 247`); `jit apply` binds the anchor from the captured config in `captured_anchor_bindings` (`template.rs:250`, binding at `:259`). `cached_namespaces` keeps readers only inside `effective_rules` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2537, 2547`). The remaining test readers are the cache-owning unit tests (`test_rules_are_parsed_once_and_cached` `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:4088`, `test_namespaces_are_parsed_once_and_cached` `:4142`, `test_rules_missing_file_yields_empty_ok` `:4192`, `test_rules_malformed_file_yields_err` `:4205`) and a `cached_config()` read in `test_effective_configuration_loads_an_authored_edit_of_a_published_registry` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:3645`, reading at `:3667`).
- Tests that call `effective_rules` directly: `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/default_rules_registry_derivation_tests.rs` (`:106, 184, 225, 254, 293`): default rules re-derive from the declared registry; `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/effective_rules_tests.rs` (`:57, 71, 86`, module doc `:1-9`): present, empty and absent `rules.toml`; `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/project_render_harness_tests.rs:217`: primes the stale cache to show render ignores it. The captured parse (`validation_declarations_from_image`, `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mod.rs:425`) implements the same present, empty, absent and reconciliation semantics, and the public captured-declaration helper exposes its rules.
- Outside storage, `load_ruleset` (`crates/jit/src/storage/ruleset_store.rs:19`) has no other production caller than `rules()`; the remaining callers are tests and doc examples (`crates/jit/src/validation/engine.rs`, `validation/local.rs`, `repository_state/rule_serialize.rs`, `profile/repository_package.rs`). The properties the cache-owning tests own besides caching (absent rules file yields an empty set, a malformed one an error) are owned by the rule-set loader and the captured parse.
- `crate::config_manager::get_hierarchy_config` (`crates/jit/src/config_manager.rs:263-275`) re-reads `config.toml`, `templates.toml` and `invariants.toml` on every call. `ConfigManager` (`crates/jit/src/config_manager.rs:28-196`) holds only a root path: `load` (`config_manager.rs:48`), `get_namespaces` (`config_manager.rs:60`), `get_write_policy` (`config_manager.rs:89`), `get_project_name` (`config_manager.rs:151`) and `get_hierarchy_icons` (`config_manager.rs:175`) read the same files, and `namespaces_from_config` (`config_manager.rs:71`), `write_policy_from_config` (`config_manager.rs:96`), `invocation_write_override` (`config_manager.rs:125`) and `project_name_from_config` (`config_manager.rs:162`) are pure conversions written as methods.
- Once the command, CLI, server, fix-pass and archive read paths take captured declarations and the executor caches are gone, the remaining `ConfigManager` users are: the executor's `config_manager` field and its import (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:105, 2123, 2176-2179`); `resolve_item_address`'s project name through that field (`crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs:479-481`); `linked_checkout_write_decision`'s `ConfigManager::new(jit_dir).get_write_policy()` (`crates/jit/src/commands/bootstrap.rs:227`, imported at `:6`), which `captured-declaration-reads` moves onto the storage loader; `invocation_write_override` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs:1625-1626, 5618`; the unit tests in `config_manager.rs` (`:277-643`, incl. `get_hierarchy_config` at `:389`); and rustdoc and comments naming `ConfigManager`: `crates/jit/src/config.rs:98, 1545`, `crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs:86-89` (whose disk write of `config.toml` at `:90-95` exists only for that reader), `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:2756`, `crates/server/src/routes.rs:1098`, `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/label_strategic_tests.rs:11`.
- `JitConfig::load` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:1361-1430`) reads the repository configuration files. Once production callers and integration tests use the storage configuration loader (`configuration-store`) and the `ConfigManager` readers above are gone, its remaining callers are `config.rs` unit tests (in `mod tests`, `crates/jit/src/config.rs:1616` onward: 19 `JitConfig::load` calls and 2 `EffectiveConfig::load` calls, including `test_load_rejects_unknown_key_by_name_in_every_table` at `:2073`). Each surviving case states a parse or merge property that the assembler's or the storage loader's tests can own.
- `loadable_rule_names` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1421-1449`), which calls `config_manager.load()`, is deleted upstream with the executor-side validation passes. The `validate --fix` hierarchy pass (`detect_and_fix_hierarchy_issues`, `validate.rs:1110-1186`, which calls `get_hierarchy_config` at `:1116`) is deleted upstream by the one-mutation fix, which derives the hierarchy fixes from its validation capture.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CommandExecutor::container_anchor` no longer exists, and the template-binding tests that called it read the anchor through the captured-declaration helper; `CommandExecutor` has no configuration, rule, namespace or `config_manager` field, and `rules()`, `effective_rules()`, `cached_config()`, `cached_namespaces()` and `repo_content_format()` no longer exist. No production code outside `crates/jit/src/storage/` calls `load_ruleset`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The tests that called `effective_rules` (the three `fast_rules` files in Background) obtain the rule set from the captured-declaration helper and each keeps its assertion; the render test keeps its stale-disk scenario without priming a cache.
- [hard] REQ-03: The cache-owning tests are deleted, the template-binding tests seed their anchor declaration into storage, the absent and malformed rules-file cases each keep one owning test at the loader or captured-parse layer, and the profile test reads its configuration from captured declarations.
- [hard] REQ-04: `get_hierarchy_config` and `ConfigManager` no longer exist, nothing under `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs` calls `get_hierarchy_config`, and `crates/jit/src/commands/bootstrap.rs` names no `ConfigManager`; `write_policy_from_config`, `invocation_write_override` and `project_name_from_config` are free functions over their inputs, their callers use them, and their unit tests keep the parsing cases the removed readers' tests asserted (namespaces, write policy, project name, icons).
- [hard] REQ-05: No rustdoc or comment names `ConfigManager`, and the test harness writes no `config.toml` to disk solely for a filesystem reader.
- [hard] REQ-06: `JitConfig::load` no longer exists, and no function in `config.rs`, `crates/jit/src/declarations/` or `crates/jit/src/templates.rs` reads the filesystem; each `config.rs` unit test that called it either asserts through the assembler over bytes or is deleted because the assembler's or storage loader's tests own the case, with no case lost.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.


## Deviations

- Production behaviour change, approved by the invoker (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): a `rules.toml` naming an optional default schema that is absent no longer fails the captured parse with `MissingCapture`; `jit validate` succeeds, as the disk loader already did. Reason: the error was a regression from moving reads to captured images, one capability must answer the same from disk and from the image (`@/charter/D-20`), and REQ-03 keeps `test_missing_default_schema_still_validates_and_enforces` unchanged. Both readers decide through one shared rule.
title: The executor holds no disk-backed configuration; ConfigManager and JitConfig::load are gone
